adoption.annualization: each original producer year convention, explicitly retained
adoption.base_improvement: CAGR >= baseline + .01 OR (continuous MDD <= baseline - .01 AND CAGR >= baseline - .01)
adoption.combination: all individually eligible compatible mechanisms, no subset search; all four stresses and actual calibrated base; adopt only own gates pass
adoption.ranking: highest worst-stress CAGR, then registered candidate order
adoption.return_increasing: both actual risk upper bands AND validation cumulative USDT return gain > 0
adoption.risk_only_alternative: both actual risk upper bands AND actual calibrated candidate continuous MDD reduction >= .01 versus actual unity baseline AND validation gain >= -.01; retain unscaled all-stress gates
adoption.targets: NOT_MET unless exact original goals pass; selection is separate from targets

baseline_equality.rule: accepted six evidence groups under existing allowed normalization; unexplained mismatch blocks promotion

candidates.delay: latest completed close <= its SMA but immediately previous completed close > its own SMA; only ordinary exit is delayed
candidates.missing: missing previous completed close/SMA history preserves original ordinary exit; cannot justify delay
candidates.name: exit-confirm
candidates.rule: ordinary SMA exit waits until BOTH latest completed close <= its current SMA AND immediately preceding completed close <= its own contemporaneous SMA; equality counts below

candidates.disclosure: risk budget, not protection against gaps
candidates.distance: actual proposal entry/stop with original fee/slip assumptions
candidates.name: stop-budget
candidates.proof: proven ownership and allocated stops required; missing ownership/protection blocks new risk
candidates.risk: proposed initial stop loss + cash fee reserves + sum(max(0, current_price - confirmed allocated protection stop) * owned_qty) of all existing owned sleeves <= .12 * current whole-account marked USDT equity
candidates.spend: min(original proposal/free cash/90% pool/capital gates, remaining risk / distance); never increase original proposal

candidates.missing: missing/stale funding/basis or causal history blocks new BUY only; safety exits remain
candidates.name: crowding-interaction
candidates.rule: halve original allowed spend only if all three conditions; otherwise preserve original proposal, including strong momentum
candidates.weak_momentum: current completed daily close <= close five completed days earlier

compatibility.scope: exit changes + new risk sizing; size factors compose without enlarging original proposal; safety priority remains

controls.disclosure: different signal/protection rules; actual protected funded accounts, not pure buy-and-hold or fixed constant weights; no fractional daily-open execution curves
controls.entry: genuine cold-start gates, no held topups or rebalances; re-entry only next completed UTC day after actual stop

basis.meaning: daily futures trade-close / spot trade-close - 1; not executable instantaneous basis
basis.observation: previous matched UTC-day completion boundary = raw available_ms - 60000

features.forward: separate newly collected observations, no retrospective backfill

funding.observation: actual settlement timestamp, preserve jitter and negative rates

features.historical_lookup: frozen window only; retained raw future tail cannot extend it
features.missing: None with explicit cause; never zero fill
features.trend: completed bars only, causal current/history checkpoints; no future bars

inventory.applicable_combination: four stresses plus actual calibrated base; no automatic one-component duplicate
inventory.fixed_budget_accounts: three budgets per repo for baseline, three for selected only if different
inventory.spot_breakdown: baseline + 3 mechanisms + cash + 4 protected participation controls, each all 4 stresses

portfolio.accounts: actual fixed funded account pairs for current default, and final selected if different
portfolio.aggregation: sum actual synchronized daily equity and closing BTC exposure
portfolio.mdd: daily joint MDD is not continuous joint MDD

research_constraints.phase_fix: none; Task1 establishes different observed marks at earliest divergence, no precise unnecessary same-observation dependency
research_constraints.prior_simple_filters: funding OR basis filters failed prior research; not registered new hypotheses
research_constraints.source_freeze: clean committed producers/evaluator and exact spec/input identities before financial measurements; originals immutable

risk_calibration.actual_base_reruns: baseline scale1 and each registered candidate
risk_calibration.disclosure: upper bands, not exact risk equality; history contaminated; intercept and CI descriptive
risk_calibration.effect: actual new order sizing after cutoff only; no held retroactive shrink or curve scaling
risk_calibration.profiles: keyed by own project candidate; bind project kind and baseline, input/spec/source identities
risk_calibration.scale_formula: min(1, baseline_train_vol/candidate_train_vol when candidate vol > 0, max(.01, baseline_train_beta)/max(.01, candidate_train_beta) when candidate beta exceeds baseline and candidate beta > 0)
risk_calibration.scale_range: 0 <= scale <= 1; no outer .01 scale floor; .01 floors only the beta ratio operands
risk_calibration.training: 2020-2021 USDT, exactly 731 days; no validation fitting

scenario_mdd_gate: every continuous proxy MDD <= corresponding baseline
